name: tx
description: Watch YouTube channels and podcasts and get TL;DRs of new uploads scored against what you want to learn. tx fetches transcripts on your computer; Codex does the analysis.

interface.shortDescription: TL;DRs of new videos from channels you follow
interface.longDescription: tx watches the YouTube channels you pick. Codex screens each new upload against a description of what you want to learn: a 0-5 score, TL;DR, takeaways with timestamps, and whether it's worth watching. Needs the tx command installed (see the README).
defaultPrompt: Use tx: set my profile to who I am and what I want to learn, then watch @fireship.
Use tx to check my channels for new videos, analyze them for me and write the digest.
Use tx to get the transcript of this video and give me a 3-bullet TL;DR:
